title: The Muse: Misunderstandings and Their Remedies
description: An open-access textbook composed to support Middle Tennessee State University's ENGL 1010: Expository Writing course. In this book, we adopt this exploratory orientation to communication, inviting you too to consider writing across contexts, its many consequent misunderstandings, and satisfying moments of remedy.
authors: Eric Detweiler - Author / Paul Evans - Author / Amy Fant - Author / Amy Harris-Aber - Author / Kate Pantelides - Author
